newsitem.title: JAPAN: Promise says to limit ATM lending hours.
newsitem.headline: Promise says to limit ATM lending hours.

text.p: Japanese consumer finance company Promise Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had decided to limit the hours when individual clients can borrow money at its automated terminals.
The company said it would no longer make loans at the terminals at night and at weekends in response to criticisms that such easy credit could lead to an increase in personal bankruptcies.

A company official said that Promise in the past had made loans of up to 100,000 yen to new customers even at night and on weekends, which he said had provoked criticism from consumer groups for causing a rise in individual bankruptcies.

Promise has therefore decided not to extend loans during those periods from now on as the company is unable to check the background of potential clients through an industry information centre, he said.
At the end of September, Promise's outstanding loans totalled 731.6 billion yen, up 16.6 percent from a year earlier, the official said.
